items.headline: Kuwait par drone hamla, Bahrain me alert
items.detail: Kuwait ki sena ne kaha uski vayu raksha 'shatrutapurna drone hamlo' ka jawab de rahi hai; Bahrain me bhi siren baje aur sena ne kai Irani hawai hamle rokne ka daava kiya.
items.exam_angle: Khadi me America-Iran tanav aur Hormuz — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Kerch Bridge par hamla, sadak hissa gira
items.detail: Ukraine ne drone aur missile se Kerch Bridge par hamla kiya; sadak wale hisse ki mehraab aur span samundar me gir gaye, rail seva aanshik roop se bahal hui.
items.exam_angle: Kerch Bridge, Crimea aur Russia-Ukraine yuddh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bangladesh me phir hinsa, BNP neta ki maut
items.detail: Faridpur me BNP neta Raju Mollah ki hatya ke baad Gopalganj me thana aur sansad ke ghar me aag lagayi gayi; Dhaka me buson me aag aur crude bomb dhamake hue.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh ki rajneeti, Sheikh Hasina ki wapsi — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Norway-Sweden: Ukraine ko $371 million
items.detail: Norway aur Sweden ne Ukraine ko hathiyaron ke liye lagbhag $371 million dene ki ghoshna ki — Norway $300 million NATO ki PURL yojana ko aur Sweden 720 million kronor dega.
items.exam_angle: NATO ki PURL yojana aur Ukraine sahayata — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Siberia me sainya viman gira, 19 ki maut
items.detail: Russia ka An-12 sainya parivahan viman Kemerovo ke paas gira; raksha mantralaya ke mutabik sawaar 19 logon ki maut ho gayi, takneeki kharabi ko shuruaati wajah bataya gaya.
items.exam_angle: Russia, sainya viman aur An-12 — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Guinea me avaidh khanan par 224 ko saza
items.detail: Guinea ki adalat ne Siguiri me avaidh sone ke khanan par 224 logon ko saza di — 22 poorv adhikariyon ko do saal aur 202 khanan-mazdooron ko teen saal ki kaid.
items.exam_angle: Avaidh khanan aur paryavaran — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: America ne Qeshm missile site par hamla kiya
items.detail: America ne Qeshm dweep par missile launch site par hawai hamle kiye — ek American adhikari ne Reuters ko pushti ki; ye Iran ke Bahrain me American thikanon par hamle ka jawab tha. (Update: pehle Iran ne America par aarop lagaya tha, ab America ne hamle ki pushti ki hai.)
items.exam_angle: US-Iran yuddh, Hormuz me tanaav — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Yemen me Saudi hamle, 7 ki maut ka daava
items.detail: Houthi media ke mutabik Saudi netritva wale gathbandhan ne Sanaa aur Hodeidah me factoryon par hamle kiye; Houthi swasthya mantralaya ne 7 ki maut batayi, Saudi ne abhi pushti nahi ki hai.
items.exam_angle: Yemen yuddh, Saudi-Houthi sangharsh — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Iran ka daava: do American drone giraye
items.detail: Iran ki sena aur IRGC ne daava kiya ki Hormuz ke paas America ke LUCAS aur MQ-1 drone giraye gaye; America ne abhi iski pushti nahi ki hai.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran yuddh me drone yuddh — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Trump: Iran hamla kare to bhari keemat
items.detail: Manila me Trump ne kaha agar Iran ne Washington par hamla kiya to use aisi keemat chukani hogi jo kisi desh ne kabhi nahi chukayi; White House ne kaha filhal koi pakka khatra nahi dikh raha, Iran ne aaropon ko 'bebuniyad' batakar kharij kiya.
items.exam_angle: US-Iran yuddh, dirty bomb aur rasayanik hathiyar — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Jericho me golibari: 72 saal ki mahila ki maut
items.detail: Duyuk al-Tahta gaon me raat ko golibari me 72 saal ki ek mahila ki maut ho gayi aur kai log ghayal hue; Filistin adhikariyon ne basne walon par aarop lagaya, Israeli sena ne kaha pehle gaadi se hamla hua tha.
items.exam_angle: West Bank, Israeli basti aur do-rashtra samadhan — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Kyiv ke pulon par hamla, 14 ki maut
items.detail: Russia ke hamle me Ukraine bhar me 14 log mare aur 78 ghayal hue; Kyiv ke Northern aur Southern pul band hue aur kai kshetron me bijli dhwast hui.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, Kyiv aur Dnipro nadi — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Netherlands sarkar bachi, sankat khatm
items.detail: Char din ke sankat ke baad PM Rob Jetten ne kaha teeno dalon ke beech vishwas bahaal ho gaya aur alpasankhyak sarkar kaam karti rahegi; vivaad dhan kar par tha.
items.exam_angle: Europe me alpasankhyak sarkar aur gathbandhan rajneeti — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: America-Thailand vyapar samjhota tay
items.detail: Manila me America aur Thailand ne parasparik vyapar samjhote (ART) par baatchit ke mool roop se poora hone ki ghoshna ki; Thailand America se aane wale saaman par tariff khatm karega.
items.exam_angle: ASEAN, America-Thailand vyapar aur reciprocal tariff — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Thaci ko 17 mahine ki aur saza
items.detail: Hague ki vishesh adalat ne Kosovo ke poorv Rashtrapati Hashim Thaci ko yuddh-apradh mukadme me gawahon ko prabhavit karne par 17 mahine ki saza di; yeh unki 25 saal ki saza ke alawa hai.
items.exam_angle: Kosovo vishesh adalat aur antarrashtriya nyay — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Dhaka airport ke paas do bam dhamake
items.detail: Dhaka ke Hazrat Shahjalal airport ke bahari gate aur Jasimuddin area me do crude bam phate; teen paidal yatri mamuli roop se ghayal hue aur suraksha badha di gayi.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh me rajnaitik tanav — UPSC ke liye upyogi.
items.image_credit: Md Shaifuzzaman Ayon, Wikimedia Commons (CC BY-SA 4.0)

items.headline: Tara Gas par doosra hamla, 1 Bharatiya lapata
items.detail: Hormuz ke paas Panama ke LPG tanker Tara Gas par doosra hamla hua; 25 ka dal jahaz chhodkar nikla, 24 surakshit mile, 1 Bharatiya navik lapata hai.
items.exam_angle: Hormuz, tel vyapar, samudri suraksha — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bulgaria ke paas LPG tanker dooba
items.detail: Liberia ke jhande wala LPG tanker Gas Husky Bulgaria ke Black Sea tat se lagbhag 50 mile door doob gaya; 19 sadasyiya amle ko surakshit bacha liya gaya, Romania ne drone hamle ka daava kiya hai, Bulgaria ne abhi pushti nahi ki.
items.exam_angle: Black Sea me samudri suraksha aur NATO — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Iran ki dhamki: bandh-bijli ghar nishane par
items.detail: Iran ke sansad adhyaksh Ghalibaf ne kaha America-Israel ke thikanon ke paas bandh, bandargah aur bijli ghar bhi 'dual-use' mane jayenge; yeh chetavni NYT ki report ke jawab me aayi.
items.exam_angle: Iran-US tanaav aur 'dual-use' siddhant — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Bangladesh 33rd parmanu-bijli wala desh
items.detail: Rooppur parmanu sanyantra ki pehli unit se 350 MW bijli pehli baar trial par national grid se judi; mantri ne kaha Bangladesh duniya ka 33rd parmanu-bijli wala desh bana.
items.exam_angle: Bangladesh, parmanu urja, Russia sahyog — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: Bahrain: Iran ka teesra drone hamla
items.detail: Iran ne Sheikh Isa Air Base par US radar ko nishana banaya — paanch din me teesra hamla; Bahrain ne drone roke, teesra US carrier bhi kshetra me pahuncha.
items.exam_angle: West Asia me tanav, Hormuz tel supply par asar.

items.headline: Zaporizhzhia par hamla: 2 ki maut, 18 ghayal
items.detail: Subah ke hamle me Zaporizhzhia ke teen jilon ki audyogik imaraton par hamla hua — 2 log mare, 18 ghayal; malbe se ek mahila zinda nikali gayi.
items.exam_angle: Russia-Ukraine yuddh, nagrik nuksan — UPSC ke liye mahatvapurna.

items.headline: Mozambique: vipaksh neta par mukadma shuru
items.detail: 2024 ke vivadit chunav ke baad hinsa par vipaksh neta Venancio Mondlane par Maputo ki Supreme Court me mukadma shuru hua; un par aatankwad bhadkane ke aarop hain, doshi paye gaye to 24 saal tak ki saza ho sakti hai.
items.exam_angle: Africa me loktantra, chunav-hinsa — UPSC ke liye upyogi.

items.headline: UK me berozgari 4.6% par aayi
items.detail: ONS ke mutabik July–September me UK ki berozgari dar 4.7% se ghatkar 4.6% hui, jabki vetan vriddhi 3.5% par dheemi padi aur October me company payroll me 34,000 ki kami aayi.
items.exam_angle: UK arthvyavastha aur Bank of England — UPSC ke liye upyogi.
